top_signals.title: Gold Slumps Below $3,800 as Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Gold dropped below $3,800 an ounce for the first time since September 2025 after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
